title: 盾尾刷與密封脂系統~Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems
focus: 以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑~Diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence
summary: 本課聚焦以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 多道刷列的阻水機制~Multiple brush-row sealing
units.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制~Multiple brush-row sealing
units.mechanism: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。多道密封提供分段阻力，但共用供應失效或同一幾何缺陷可能同時破壞多列。 假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。~Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. Multiple rows add barriers, but shared supply failure or a common geometric defect can defeat them together. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence.
units.verify: 以系統圖標示刷列、供應線、壓力感測與共用設備，檢查失效是否真正獨立；比對各區消耗及漏水位置，設備主管需審查共因情境，不把多道數量直接換成可靠度保證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。~Map rows, supply lines, sensors and shared equipment and test whether failures are independent; compare zone consumption and leakage location, with equipment review of common causes rather than reliability guaranteed by barrier count. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system.
units.failure: 三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。~Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system.
units.misconception: 多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。~Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄多道刷列的阻水機制的資料來源與適用條件。以系統圖標示刷列、供應線、壓力感測與共用設備，檢查失效是否真正獨立；比對各區消耗及漏水位置，設備主管需審查共因情境，不把多道數量直接換成可靠度保證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for multiple brush-row sealing. Map rows, supply lines, sensors and shared equipment and test whether failures are independent; compare zone consumption and leakage location, with equipment review of common causes rather than reliability guaranteed by barrier count.

units.anchor: 尾隙與偏心分布~Tail clearance and eccentricity
units.title: 尾隙與偏心分布~Tail clearance and eccentricity
units.mechanism: 盾尾環隙沿圓周不均，盾體偏心使一側壓縮而另一側放大。密封需求由最不利局部間隙控制，平均環隙相同不代表刷毛接觸相同，組環姿態和盾體運動需共同考慮。 假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。 偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。~Tail clearance varies around the circumference. Eccentricity compresses one side and opens the other, so local extremes govern brush contact even with unchanged mean clearance. Ring attitude and shield movement must be considered together. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization.
units.verify: 將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。~Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima; review against approved equipment and lining geometry rather than accepting only an average or one measurement. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved.
units.failure: 偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。~Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved.
units.misconception: 盾尾平均間隙正常就保證整圈刷毛接觸都正常。~Normal mean tail clearance guarantees adequate brush contact around the entire circumference.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄尾隙與偏心分布的資料來源與適用條件。將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tail clearance and eccentricity. Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima; review against approved equipment and lining geometry rather than accepting only an average or one measurement.

units.anchor: 密封壓差與高程~Seal differential pressure and elevation
units.title: 密封壓差與高程~Seal differential pressure and elevation
units.mechanism: 密封面承受外部水與灌漿壓力，內部感測值需修正高程和管線損失才可比較。量到供應端高壓不表示刷列間實際壓力足夠，因為堵塞或黏性損失可消耗大部分壓差。 假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。 供應管堵塞可呈現高壓但沒有材料到達刷列，若把儀表高值當成功密封，外部水土可能逐步侵入；漏水初期未必伴隨供應壓力降低。~The seal resists external water and grout, while internal readings require elevation and line-loss correction. High supply-end pressure does not establish cavity pressure because blockage and viscous losses can consume much of the differential. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure. A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium. Mistaking that reading for successful sealing permits progressive ingress, which need not initially reduce measured supply pressure at all.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure.
units.verify: 核對壓力計位置、零點與介質狀態，對照供應端和靠近密封區的紀錄；設備工程師需判別高壓低流量是否阻塞，任何調整依核准程序，算例只幫助壓力基準換算。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：供應管堵塞可呈現高壓但沒有材料到達刷列，若把儀表高值當成功密封，外部水土可能逐步侵入；漏水初期未必伴隨供應壓力降低。~Check sensor position, zero and medium state and compare supply with near-seal records; equipment engineers distinguish blockage indicated by high pressure and low flow, with changes only under approved procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium. Mistaking that reading for successful sealing permits progressive ingress, which need not initially reduce measured supply pressure at all.
units.failure: 供應管堵塞可呈現高壓但沒有材料到達刷列，若把儀表高值當成功密封，外部水土可能逐步侵入；漏水初期未必伴隨供應壓力降低。~A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium. Mistaking that reading for successful sealing permits progressive ingress, which need not initially reduce measured supply pressure at all.
units.misconception: 供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。~High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄密封壓差與高程的資料來源與適用條件。核對壓力計位置、零點與介質狀態，對照供應端和靠近密封區的紀錄；設備工程師需判別高壓低流量是否阻塞，任何調整依核准程序，算例只幫助壓力基準換算。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for seal differential pressure and elevation. Check sensor position, zero and medium state and compare supply with near-seal records; equipment engineers distinguish blockage indicated by high pressure and low flow, with changes only under approved procedures.

units.anchor: 密封消耗與有效補充~Consumption and effective replenishment
units.title: 密封消耗與有效補充~Consumption and effective replenishment
units.mechanism: 密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。停機期間的消耗與推進期間意義不同，應區分時間基準與距離基準。 假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。~Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids. Consumption per advance supports trending without proving performance. Standstill consumption differs physically from advancing consumption, requiring both time and distance references. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill. Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill.
units.verify: 以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。~Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.
units.failure: 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。~Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.
units.misconception: 密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。~Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄密封消耗與有效補充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for consumption and effective replenishment. Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability.

units.anchor: 流變與輸送相容~Rheology and delivery compatibility
units.title: 流變與輸送相容~Rheology and delivery compatibility
units.mechanism: 密封介質需兼顧可泵送、黏附及抗水沖，溫度改變會同時影響輸送阻力與保持能力。只以黏度高低排序忽略剪切與時間效應，產品相容性及設備適用範圍需由正式試驗確認。 假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。~Sealing medium balances pumpability, adhesion and washout resistance. Temperature affects both transport and retention, so viscosity alone misses shear and time effects; compatibility and equipment suitability require qualified testing. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%. Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%.
units.verify: 比較代表溫度下的供應資料和合格流變試驗，記錄材料批號與停留時間；將泵送壓損和抗水試驗分別評估，設備工程師核准相容材料，課程不提供配方或加壓方法。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。~Compare qualified rheology and supplier evidence at representative temperatures with batch and residence records; assess delivery loss separately from water resistance, leaving material approval to equipment engineers without recipes or pressurization instructions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation.
units.failure: 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。~Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation.
units.misconception: 常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。~Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄流變與輸送相容的資料來源與適用條件。比較代表溫度下的供應資料和合格流變試驗，記錄材料批號與停留時間；將泵送壓損和抗水試驗分別評估，設備工程師核准相容材料，課程不提供配方或加壓方法。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rheology and delivery compatibility. Compare qualified rheology and supplier evidence at representative temperatures with batch and residence records; assess delivery loss separately from water resistance, leaving material approval to equipment engineers without recipes or pressurization instructions.

units.anchor: 環片表面與接觸~Segment surface and contact
units.title: 環片表面與接觸~Segment surface and contact
units.mechanism: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。防水問題因此不僅是密封材料，也包含環片製造與組裝品質，缺陷位置要能追到環號方位。 假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。 未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。~Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. Sealing therefore depends on manufacturing and assembly quality as well as medium, requiring defects to be traceable by ring and angle. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction. A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction.
units.verify: 在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。~Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings.
units.failure: 未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。~A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings.
units.misconception: 環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。~A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄環片表面與接觸的資料來源與適用條件。在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for segment surface and contact. Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes.

units.anchor: 灌漿與密封交互作用~Grouting and seal interaction
units.title: 灌漿與密封交互作用~Grouting and seal interaction
units.mechanism: 盾尾外的灌漿填補環隙，也可能對密封施加暫態壓力或讓硬化材料侵入刷列。灌漿與密封系統應協調時間、位置與壓力證據，不能各自看儀表正常就假定介面無問題。 假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。 灌漿倒入刷列後硬化會降低柔順接觸，表面暫時止漏卻可能造成後續破壞；不同系統時鐘不一致又會掩蓋兩者的因果關聯。~Backfill outside the tail closes the annulus but can load seals transiently or introduce hardening material into brushes. Grout and seal systems need coordinated time, location and pressure evidence rather than isolated normal readings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary. Grout hardening in brushes reduces compliant contact; temporary apparent sealing can precede later damage. Unsynchronized system clocks further conceal the causal link between grout events and seal deterioration.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary.
units.verify: 同步灌漿口與密封分區資料，核對高程與感測位置並追蹤材料硬化時間；漏水或消耗變化需查是否與特定灌漿事件重合，由灌漿及設備負責人共同審查介面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：灌漿倒入刷列後硬化會降低柔順接觸，表面暫時止漏卻可能造成後續破壞；不同系統時鐘不一致又會掩蓋兩者的因果關聯。~Synchronize grout-port and seal-zone records with elevation, sensor location and setting time; investigate whether leakage or consumption changes coincide with specific grouting events, with joint grout and equipment review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Grout hardening in brushes reduces compliant contact; temporary apparent sealing can precede later damage. Unsynchronized system clocks further conceal the causal link between grout events and seal deterioration.

units.misconception: 灌漿和密封各自儀表正常就不必檢查彼此介面。~Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄灌漿與密封交互作用的資料來源與適用條件。同步灌漿口與密封分區資料，核對高程與感測位置並追蹤材料硬化時間；漏水或消耗變化需查是否與特定灌漿事件重合，由灌漿及設備負責人共同審查介面。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for grouting and seal interaction. Synchronize grout-port and seal-zone records with elevation, sensor location and setting time; investigate whether leakage or consumption changes coincide with specific grouting events, with joint grout and equipment review.

units.anchor: 漏水量與趨勢判讀~Leakage rate and trend interpretation
units.title: 漏水量與趨勢判讀~Leakage rate and trend interpretation
units.mechanism: 可見漏水量受收集範圍、排水混流與壓差影響，不能把排水泵總量全歸盾尾。持續上升或混入細土比單次清水滴漏更需追查，量測應將來源和時間分開。 假設專用收集槽5 min增加30 L，平均漏量6 L/min=0.1 L/s；未分流總排水不適用。 排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。~Observed leakage depends on collection area, mixed drainage and pressure difference; total sump pumping is not all tail leakage. Rising flow or fines warrants distinct investigation, with sources and time explicitly separated. An assumed dedicated tank gaining 30 L in 5 min indicates 6 L/min=0.1 L/s; mixed drainage cannot support the same attribution. Wash water creates false leakage trends, while deposited fines can reduce collected flow despite continuing erosion. Flow alone without source and solids evidence cannot establish that deterioration has stopped.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設專用收集槽5 min增加30 L，平均漏量6 L/min=0.1 L/s；未分流總排水不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed dedicated tank gaining 30 L in 5 min indicates 6 L/min=0.1 L/s; mixed drainage cannot support the same attribution.
units.verify: 採核准安全方式辨識收集來源，使用計量槽或流量計並記錄濁度與壓差；比對分區密封和施工事件，任何異常依既定應變計畫由負責人處理，不能靠學徒自行追入受壓區。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。~Identify collection sources under approved safe access and measure flow with turbidity and pressure context; correlate seal zones and events, referring anomalies through the response plan rather than entering pressurized areas independently. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Wash water creates false leakage trends, while deposited fines can reduce collected flow despite continuing erosion. Flow alone without source and solids evidence cannot establish that deterioration has stopped.

units.misconception: 排水泵總量可以全部直接歸因於盾尾密封漏水。~All sump-pump discharge can be attributed directly to tail-seal leakage.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄漏水量與趨勢判讀的資料來源與適用條件。採核准安全方式辨識收集來源，使用計量槽或流量計並記錄濁度與壓差；比對分區密封和施工事件，任何異常依既定應變計畫由負責人處理，不能靠學徒自行追入受壓區。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for leakage rate and trend interpretation. Identify collection sources under approved safe access and measure flow with turbidity and pressure context; correlate seal zones and events, referring anomalies through the response plan rather than entering pressurized areas independently.

units.anchor: 停機保存與劣化~Standstill preservation and deterioration
units.title: 停機保存與劣化~Standstill preservation and deterioration
units.mechanism: 停機時盾尾仍承受外壓，介質可能被沖失、沉降或隨溫度變化，刷毛也可能被硬化漿體固定。停止前正常不能保證重啟前正常，狀態確認需要看整段停機歷程。 假設停機24 h消耗36 kg，平均1.5 kg/h；此觀測不能轉成通用補充週期或允許停機時限。 供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。~External loading persists during stoppage while medium washes out, settles or changes with temperature, and grout may immobilize brushes. A normal pre-stop state does not guarantee a normal restart state; the complete standstill history matters. Assumed 36 kg consumption during a 24 h standstill averages 1.5 kg/h; it does not prescribe a universal replenishment interval or allowable stop duration. Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. Leakage on restart then reveals damage whose earlier evidence was missed.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設停機24 h消耗36 kg，平均1.5 kg/h；此觀測不能轉成通用補充週期或允許停機時限。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed 36 kg consumption during a 24 h standstill averages 1.5 kg/h; it does not prescribe a universal replenishment interval or allowable stop duration.
units.verify: 按設備核准計畫檢查停機期間壓力、消耗與漏水，保留供應中斷及溫度事件；重啟前由設備及施工主管確認幾何和密封證據，不能僅因泵浦可運轉就視為已恢復功能。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。~Review pressure, consumption and leakage through the approved standstill plan, retaining interruptions and temperature events; equipment and construction leads verify geometry and seal evidence before restart rather than relying on pump operation alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. Leakage on restart then reveals damage whose earlier evidence was missed.
units.failure: 供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。~Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. Leakage on restart then reveals damage whose earlier evidence was missed.
units.misconception: 停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。~No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄停機保存與劣化的資料來源與適用條件。按設備核准計畫檢查停機期間壓力、消耗與漏水，保留供應中斷及溫度事件；重啟前由設備及施工主管確認幾何和密封證據，不能僅因泵浦可運轉就視為已恢復功能。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for standstill preservation and deterioration. Review pressure, consumption and leakage through the approved standstill plan, retaining interruptions and temperature events; equipment and construction leads verify geometry and seal evidence before restart rather than relying on pump operation alone.

units.anchor: 密封狀態工程移交~Seal-condition engineering handover
units.title: 密封狀態工程移交~Seal-condition engineering handover
units.mechanism: 密封系統的剩餘性能不能由道數或使用時間單獨判斷，需結合幾何、消耗、漏水與材料歷程。班次交接保留不一致訊號及限制，才不會把尚待調查的問題當成已修復。 假設12個監測分區有9個完整資料，覆蓋75%；缺失3區若相鄰，不能視為均勻隨機缺測。 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。~Remaining seal capability cannot be inferred from row count or age alone; geometry, consumption, leakage and material history must agree. Shift handover retains discrepancies and limitations so an unresolved problem is not mistaken for a completed repair. If 9 of an assumed 12 zones have complete records, coverage is 75%; 3 adjacent missing zones are not uniformly random omissions. Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設12個監測分區有9個完整資料，覆蓋75%；缺失3區若相鄰，不能視為均勻隨機缺測。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 12 zones have complete records, coverage is 75%; 3 adjacent missing zones are not uniformly random omissions.
units.verify: 逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。~Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.
units.failure: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。~Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.
units.misconception: 監測資料覆蓋比例高，就可以忽略相鄰缺測區的風險。~High overall monitoring coverage permits ignoring risk in adjacent unmeasured zones.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄密封狀態工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for seal-condition engineering handover. Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence.

教學量化備忘：假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization.

教學量化備忘：假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure.
教學量化備忘：假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill.

教學量化備忘：假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。~Teaching quantitative note: If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%.

教學量化備忘：假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction.
